stories.title: Judge Issues Temporary Block on Trump's Golf Course Redevelopment in Washington, D.C.
stories.summary: A federal judge has temporarily halted plans by the Trump administration to close East Potomac Park for a golf course redevelopment. The ruling prevents the park from being closed to the public for at least two weeks, as the administration had intended to begin renovations. Trump has criticized the decision and indicated plans to appeal the ruling.

stories.title: Zelenskyy Warns Starshield Restrictions Compromise Ukraine's Energy Defense Ahead of Winter
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed concerns that restrictions on the Starshield satellite communications system are undermining Ukraine's ability to defend its energy infrastructure against Russian attacks. He stated that these limitations hinder the interception of Russian drones, particularly as winter approaches, a time when attacks on Ukraine's power grid typically escalate. Zelenskyy has called on the U.S. and Elon Musk to lift these restrictions to bolster Ukraine's defenses.

stories.title: Massive Protests Erupt in Czech Republic Against Public Media Funding Overhaul
stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Czechs gathered in Prague to protest against the government's proposed changes to public media funding. The plan aims to eliminate mandatory license fees and shift funding to the state budget, which critics argue could increase government control over media. Organizers estimated the crowd at around 350,000, marking one of the largest protests in the country's history.

stories.title: All Rescued After Tanker Collision with Cruise Ship on Mississippi River
stories.summary: A tanker collided with a luxury paddle wheeler docked in New Orleans, causing the cruise vessel to roll over and sink. Fortunately, all passengers were rescued without fatalities, leading to the incident being referred to as a 'miracle on the Mississippi.' In response, New Orleans port officials have filed a lawsuit seeking at least $1 million in damages and requesting control of the tanker involved in the crash.

stories.title: Collision Between UPS Cargo Plane and Copa Airlines Jet at Miami Airport Results in Minor Injuries
stories.summary: A UPS cargo plane and a Copa Airlines passenger jet collided while taxiing at Miami International Airport. The incident involved the wingtip of the passenger jet striking the nose of the cargo aircraft. Two individuals were treated for minor injuries at the scene, according to airport officials. The Federal Aviation Administration is currently investigating the collision.

stories.title: Estonia to Close All Border Crossings with Russia Following Drone Factory Attack
stories.summary: Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia starting December 1, following a suspected sabotage attack on Threod Systems, a drone manufacturer. Authorities have linked the attack to Russia's GRU military intelligence service, claiming it is part of hybrid warfare. Eight individuals were arrested in connection with the incident, which involved an attempted arson at the facility.

stories.title: Spain Reports Nearly 2,200 Migrants Arrive in Canary Islands Over Two Days
stories.summary: Spain has reported that nearly 2,200 migrants reached the Canary Islands within a two-day period. This surge in arrivals, particularly from sub-Saharan Africa, prompted Spain to declare a migration emergency on November 11. The situation reflects a significant increase in migration attempts to the islands in recent weeks.

stories.title: SpaceX Achieves Midair Capture of Starship After Orbital Flight
stories.summary: SpaceX's Starship successfully returned from orbit and was captured by launch pad arms in a notable first. The spacecraft's journey lasted 22 hours, culminating in a dramatic midair catch at the Texas launch tower. However, the mission faced challenges as the first-stage booster exploded shortly after liftoff, preventing a planned double catch.

The event took place in Bangkok, featuring eleven competing countries. The grand final showcased a variety of performances over two and a half hours.
